referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This dataset includes the phases C1–C4 of asphalt disposal. C1: Deconstruction with a road milling machine (removal of asphalt from the pavement). The deconstruction data are taken from Project 3 ‘Standardized Method for the Life Cycle Assessment of Pavements’ of the platform Gravel for Generations. Emissions are based on the study from "J. Lenk, «Ökobilanz (LCA) von Gussasphalt als Deckschicht auf Schweizer Nationalstrassen, Anhang,» Masterthesis, Burgdorf, 2023". C2: Transport to waste treatment. C3: Waste treatment. The environmental impacts of recycling reclaimed asphalt are allocated economically between the disposal service (C3) and the new life cycle (material provision of RAP, A1). Since the RAP data refer to 1 t of output (RAP), they were converted to the treatment of 1 t of reclaimed asphalt. The scaling factor of 0.935 results from the 935 kg of RAP obtained from processing 1 t of reclaimed asphalt. C4: Transport to landfill.
referenceFunction.name: Disposal, asphalt construction waste

technology.text: This process involves the use of a road milling machine for asphalt removal from the pavement, transport with a EURO6 truck, and processing into RAP taking into account the allocation factor.

timePeriod.text: Review of data currency scheduled after 5 years.
